'''Ken Cross''' (DeckTech handle '''Squires''')<ref name="dt-24668">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24668 Squires Origins Profit], DeckTech (Ken "Squires" Cross, 29 July 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24668/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24668/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009042401/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24668/ Wayback Machine].</ref> played the [[2025 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-09-world-championship-seattle-washington-october-4-5-2025/ 2025 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> He finished 7th at the [[2002 Origins Open]] with a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]] list (''Squires Origins Profit'').
